resolution: Fixed the WorldViewport hot-reload crash caused by changing pushLiveWorld from two arguments to three. Retained component closures could omit authoredPieces, and authoredPieceFrom called .find on undefined. The resolver now accepts a missing snapshot and falls back to the mirrored authored registry, preserving both base and paint-skin lookups; the new argument is optional for backward compatibility. Added a regression test and rebuilt the ReleaseFast editor successfully.
